ttlock_client_id.title: Client ID
ttlock_client_id.description: TTLock Open Platform application client ID (https://euopen.ttlock.com)

ttlock_client_secret.title: Client secret
ttlock_client_secret.description: TTLock Open Platform application client secret

ttlock_username.title: Username
ttlock_username.description: TTLock account username (recommended: the plugin logs in and renews the token automatically)

ttlock_access_token.title: Access token
ttlock_access_token.description: Alternative to username/password: a pre-generated access token (it cannot be renewed automatically)

ttlock_api_base_url.title: API base URL
ttlock_api_base_url.description: TTLock API base URL, e.g. https://api.sciener.com or https://euapi.ttlock.com

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh lock state and battery level. Minimum 30, 0 disables polling.

whiteList.description: Only expose locks with these names or IDs (empty exposes all)

blackList.description: Never expose locks with these names or IDs

debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
